exposure: knowledge of postpartum PFD risk/protective factors
awareness of postpartum PFD risk/protective factors
outcome: perception of CS as protective against PFD
cohort: Healthcare professionals (physicians, midwives, physiotherapists) involved in obstetric or postpartum care in Germany participated in an anonymous online survey.
finding: While the majority of healthcare professionals demonstrated high awareness and knowledge regarding postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction, only 36.8% reported routinely providing postpartum counseling for PFD prevention, indicating a gap between knowledge and practice.
mod_finding: Physicians were significantly more likely than midwives to view cesarean section as protective against PFD (28.8% vs. 9.3%) and to consider it for themselves or their partners (27.2% vs. 8.3%).
